messages:
Alex: quick privacy question — I noticed our SCIM provisioner is logging sso_identity and user email in plaintext to /var/log/scim-provisioner.log, e.g. 
```
INFO 2024-10-02 12:03:45 Provisioner - created user {id: 1234, sso_identity: "github:alice", email: "alice@example.com"}
```
Is that acceptable or should we redact/hash before writing? :eyes:

Sam: we never added explicit redaction for sso_identity — we mask tokens and passwords but left identity fields for debugging a while back. not ideal for prod logs.

Priya: policy check: emails and external IDs are treated as PII. For audit logs we allow identifiers but avoid plaintext emails where possible. preferred: store internal user_id + hashed external id, or redact emails and store a salted hash for correlation. also add ACLs on the log index. :lock:

Maria: from compliance/GDPR POV we can store emails if we have legal basis, but retention+access controls matter. shorter retention + redaction is safer and reduces risk. If you can replace email with user_id or one-way hash, that's best.

Alex: sounds like action: 1) stop logging raw email/sso_identity 2) add hashing middleware in provisioner 3) rotate log retention to 30 days for provisioning indices 4) update runbook. ok to proceed?

Sam: putting together a tiny middleware now. plan: before writing log, run `hashid = hmac_sha256(LOG_SALT, sso_identity)` and log only `sso_identity_hash`. will open PR and include config toggle. ETA: EOD today.

Priya: please include unit test verifying no plaintext email appears in logs and an env var toggle to keep old behaviour for debugging on sandbox only. also add migration note for historical logs.

Alex: pinging @Maria for retention approval on the index change.

Maria: approved for 30d retention on provisioning logs. please add a short note in the privacy register and inform infosec.

Sam: created PR: https://git.redwood.local/scim/provisioner/pulls/78 — includes middleware + tests + docs. cc @Priya @Alex.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued: scim-provisioner/branch/feature/log-redact -> staging (build 215).

Alex: thanks — once staging looks good, schedule rollout to prod with brief maintenance note. also add a small alert if any log lines match email regex after redaction.

Priya: can do a quick post-deploy audit script. i'll run across last 7 days after prod deploy.

Sam: noted, will add alert and link to PR. closing thread after deploy. :white_check_mark:
